name: get promotes a key and insertion evicts the least recent key
input: capacity two with two inserts one read and one new insert
test:
cache = ManualLRUCache(2)
assert cache.put('a', 1) is None
assert cache.put('b', 2) is None
assert cache.keys_mru_to_lru() == ['b', 'a']
assert cache.get('a') == 1
assert cache.put('c', 3) == ('b', 2)
assert cache.keys_mru_to_lru() == ['c', 'a']
assert cache.get('b') is None

name: updating an existing key moves it without eviction
input: capacity two with an existing-key replacement
test:
cache = ManualLRUCache(2)
cache.put('a', 1)
cache.put('b', 2)
assert cache.put('a', 10) is None
assert cache.keys_mru_to_lru() == ['a', 'b']
assert cache.get('a') == 10
assert cache.put('c', 3) == ('b', 2)

name: remove and missing gets preserve a coherent list
input: a missing get, a present removal, and a repeated removal
test:
cache = ManualLRUCache(3)
cache.put('a', 1)
cache.put('b', 2)
assert cache.get('missing', 'fallback') == 'fallback'
assert cache.keys_mru_to_lru() == ['b', 'a']
assert cache.remove('a') is True
assert cache.remove('a') is False
assert cache.keys_mru_to_lru() == ['b']
